description:
This is a notice of the Government's intent to solicit, negotiate and award a sole source contract to Advantor Systems.

The intent of this contract is to procure the delivery and installation of an additional alarm system in a secure location within building 1614 on Hanscom AFB. Advantor Systems shall provide all labor, equipment, and materials required to install the ACS/IDS in accordance with the Intelligence Community Directive Number 705, DoD Special Access Program Security Manual, UL 2050, Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules, and the Technical Specification for SCIF Construction.
